texts.zh: 该文明的母星系边缘，一个神秘的传送门赫然耸立，危险的实体从中汨汨涌出。这些入侵者不请自来，让人无处可避，迫使人们只能仰依赖他们最杰出的科技杰作——深空擎天堡。
texts.en: A mysterious portal looms at the edge of this civilization's home system, a gateway from which hostile entities emerge in relentless waves. These invasions are as unpredictable as they are inevitable, forcing the people to rely on their greatest technological triumph - the Deep Space Citadel.

sections.zh:
我们并不是天生如此警觉。

[Capital.GetName]是一颗富饶的星球，我们也曾是和平富足的人民。但有一天，这个传送门改变了一切。

这群[GetInvadersLower]不请自来。他们在我们的城市和土地上肆虐，又突然跟他们的凭空出现一样消失得无影无踪。我们曾以为这只是偶然，然而这种入侵便一发不可收拾。它们一次又一次地来袭，变得越来越凶残。

现在，我们即将步入星系，天空卫士们为此做好了准备。在我们母星的深空中，强大的深空擎天堡静静守望。这是一座坚不可摧的垣壁，抵御[GetInvadersLower]或其他想要摧毁我们的东西。
sections.en:
We were not always so vigilant.

[Capital.GetName] is a world of abundance, and once, we were a peaceful and contented people. But all that changed when the portal opened.

Without warning, the [GetInvadersLower] arrived. They razed our cities, ravaged our lands, and then, as swiftly as they had come, they vanished. We dared hope they would never return. But the invasions resumed, again and again, each attack more brutal than the last.

Now, as we prepare to venture into the galaxy, our Skywatchers stand ready. High above our world, the formidable Deep Space Citadel awaits, a steadfast bulwark against the [GetInvadersLower] and any others who seek our destruction.

texts.zh:
天空卫士汇报事态有令人警觉的进展。

最近在[Root.Capital.System.GetName]的传送门中探测到了一种极其微弱但绝对不会搞错的波动。在过去，类似的扰动总会带来一大波敌意的生物舰船。

如果这些数据真实可信，我们知道我下一波攻击会在数月之内到达。人民的生死存亡再一次交由我们的守卫者们保护了。
texts.en:
Our Skywatchers have reported an alarming development.

Subtle but unmistakable fluctuations were recently detected within the portal in [Root.Capital.System.GetName]. In the past, similar disturbances have heralded waves of hostile biological vessels.

If these readings hold true, we can expect the next assault within a matter of months. The survival of our people may once again depend on the resolve of our defenders.

texts.zh:
[GetInvadersLower]攻击了我们数十年。我们的深空擎天堡 I是第一道防线，但只有解开这些敌人的谜团才能真正带来安全。

每个发现都会带我们向着最终的目标推进，我们终将可以发起反抗，终结我们长久以来的围城。
texts.en:
The [GetInvadersLower] have attacked us for decades. Our Deep Space Citadel I stands as the first line of defense, but true safety will only be won by uncovering the truth about our enemies.

With each discovery, we move closer to the day when we can take our fight to them - and our long siege once and for all.

texts.zh:
我们摧毁的生物舰队残骸在[Root.Capital.System.GetName]不祥地飘荡着。虽然它们几乎成了扭曲的焦炭，但大部分有机物质仍然完好无损，为研究提供了难得的机会。

通过仔细的分析，我们也许能够揭开它们奇特结构的秘密——也许还能对它们出现的神秘传送门有所了解。
texts.en:
The debris left by the annihilated biological fleet drifts ominously through [Root.Capital.System.GetName]. Though twisted and charred, much of the organic material remains intact, offering a rare opportunity for study.

With careful analysis, we may be able to uncover the secrets of their grotesque construction - and perhaps glean some insight into the enigmatic portal from which they emerge.

texts.zh: [GetInvadersLower]舰队的残留物带来了一个罕有的研究击毁。我们可以从中学到许多有助于生存的知识。
texts.en: The remains of the [GetInvadersLower] fleet provide a rare opportunity for study. We may learn much to ensure our survival.

texts.zh:
在费劲地研究了[Root.Capital.System.GetName]里留下的残骸后，我们的[Root.GetScientistPlural]觉得他们应该找到了理解我们星系边缘耸立着的传送门的关键所在。

在这种生物的体内深处，发现了一种有机组织——它似乎与传送门的波动会发生共鸣。通过对该频率进行逆向工程，我们应该可以让自己穿越这个神秘的裂缝。

目前仍需要进一步研究，但我们反击的机会前所未有地触手可及了。
texts.en:
After painstaking study of the biological wreckage left in [Root.Capital.System.GetName], our [Root.GetScientistPlural] believe they may have the key to understanding the portal that looms at the edge of our system.

Deep within the creatures' tissue, an organic pattern has been identified - one that seems to resonate with the portal's fluctuations. By reverse-engineering this frequency, we should be able to traverse the enigmatic rift ourselves.

Further research will be necessary, but for the first time the possibility of taking the fight to the enemy is within reach.

texts.zh:
我们又离揭开传送门的奥秘近了一步。尽管还是无法穿越，但我们现在已经拥有了发展必要科技所需的洞见

想要反抗这些敌人，我们需要虫洞稳定。
texts.en:
We are one step closer to unlocking the portal's mysteries. Though passage is not yet possible, we now have the insight needed to develop the necessary technology.

To bring our fight to the enemy, we require Wormhole Stabilization.

texts.zh:
多亏了我们近期在虫洞稳定领域的突破，我们现在得以一瞥[event_target:starlit_sealed_system.GetName]恒星系。

一支充满侵略性的生物舰队和一个戒备森严的恒星基地在另一头等着我们。建议谨慎行事。

我们找到了敌人的老巢。
texts.en:
Thanks to our recent breakthrough in Wormhole Stabilization we have been offered a rare glimpse of the [event_target:starlit_sealed_system.GetName] system.

An aggressive fleet of biological vessels and a heavily fortified starbase await us on the far side. Extreme caution is advised.

We have found the cradle of the enemy.

texts.zh:
我们发现了敌人的老巢，但是要揭开他们的秘密就要直面他们的防御。

这会是一场恶仗，但在这之后我们最终将能探索[event_target:starlit_sealed_system.GetName]恒星系。
texts.en:
We have found the cradle of our enemy, but to unlock their secrets it will be necessary to confront their defenses.

The battle will not be easy, but in its aftermath we will at last be free to explore the [event_target:starlit_sealed_system.GetName] system.

texts.zh:
盘踞在[starlit_sealed_system.GetName]的舰队被摧毁了。在结束前一刻，我们收到了一个来自星系恒星基地的微弱信号，我们目前只翻译出的一条是：

“—全部失联！这是他们自己生产的舰船！无论你是谁，请救救我们！”

随后，所有的通讯就终止了。如果这真的是一场胜利，我们敌人的集结地给了我们一个战略击毁。也许，可以有一座深空擎天堡 I沐浴着[starlit_sealed_system.GetName]的光，来确保不会再有这样的敌人来威胁我们的文明。
texts.en:
The fleet guarding [starlit_sealed_system.GetName] has been destroyed. Just before the end, we received a haunting transmission from the system's starbase, one which we have only now translated:

" - lost all control! The ships are reproducing by themselves! Please, whoever you are, save us!"

Since then, all communication has ceased. If this is indeed victory, our enemy's staging ground offers a strategic opportunity. A new Deep Space Citadel I may one day shine in the light of [starlit_sealed_system.GetName], ensuring that such a threat never imperils our civilization again.

label.en: At last, our siege is lifted.

texts.zh: [GetInvadersLower]的母星系；它们是谁？它们到底打我们什么主意？
texts.en: The home world of the [GetInvadersLower]; who were these people, and what did they want with us?

texts.zh:
[event_target:biomechanical_world_target.GetName]是一片露天坟地。

这颗星球上的优势物种完全被一种奇怪的侵略性生命形式所侵占。进一步的调查显示，它们并不是天然的有机体而是某种生物机器，而且并非建造而是生长而来。

不知是否有可能是这些生物的设计者被自己的创物反噬了？我们的敌人难道完全不知道对他们的行动毫无自知之明，甚至不连我们的存在都不知道吗？

只有一件事可以肯定：无论他们采取了什么措施来控制这场瘟疫，这都导致了他们自己以及他们自动制造的可憎之物的毁灭。
texts.en:
[event_target:biomechanical_world_target.GetName] is an open grave.

The planet's dominant species was completely overrun by a strange and aggressive form of life. Further investigation revealed that these were no natural organisms, but rather biological machines, seemingly grown rather than built.

Is it possible that whoever engineered these creatures was overwhelmed by their own creation? Could our enemy have been completely unaware of their actions against us, or even of our existence?

Only one thing is certain: whatever measures they took to contain this plague destroyed them, along with their automated abominations.

label.zh: 所以我们并不是唯一的受害者……
label.en: Then we were not the only victims...

texts.zh:
[starlit_sealed_system.GetName]恒星系内的[GetInvadersLower]被清除干净了，但这里的情况却出乎我们的意料。

曾经在我们土地上肆虐的敌人现在只剩下一颗饱受摧残的星球。
texts.en:
The [GetInvadersLower] have been purged from the [starlit_sealed_system.GetName] system, but the situation here is very different from what we expected.

All that remains of our tormentors is an apparently decimated world.

texts.zh:
传送门另一端的遥测数据揭示了[event_target:starlit_sealed_system.GetName]的一个关键进展：生物舰船和他们的孵化场都被一支未知的力量摧毁了。

尽管知道[GetInvadersLower]被葬送之后都非常高兴，但我们无法忽视另一支力量也许有一天就会控制住[event_target:starlit_sealed_system.GetName]恒星系的风险。

我们必须加快脚步确保这一战略要地不会落入到另一个敌人的手中。
texts.en:
Incoming telemetry from the portal reveals a critical development in [event_target:starlit_sealed_system.GetName]: both the fleet of biological ships and their hatchery have been destroyed by an unknown force.

Even as we rejoice in knowing that the [GetInvadersLower] have met their end, we cannot ignore the risk that another power may one day seize control of the [event_target:starlit_sealed_system.GetName] system.

We must move quickly to secure this strategic location before we face yet another siege.

label.en: At last, our siege is lifted.

texts.zh:
我们在观察生物飞船攻击的过程中发现了一个令人不安的趋势。每一波攻击都显示出更高的协调性、适应性战术以及对我们防御系统的系统性试探。敏感器日志揭示了能量特征的变化和攻击优先级的调整，这些都是策略演变的证据。

这些生物，无论是通过本能还是集体智慧，正变得越来越强大。如果这种模式持续下去，下一波攻击将更加难以抵御。
texts.en:
We have witnessed a troubling trend in the biological ship attacks. Each wave displays improved coordination, adaptive tactics, and a methodical probing of our defenses. Sensor logs reveal shifts in energy signatures and targeting priorities, evidence of evolving strategies.

These creatures, whether through instinct or collective intelligence, are becoming more formidable. If this pattern continues, the next wave will be even harder to repel.

tooltips.zh: 随着每一波次的到来，通过古怪的传送门抵达的舰队实力都不断增强。
tooltips.en: With each successive wave, fleets arriving through the Strange Portal gain potency.
